About CodeRoad

CodeRoad is a technology execution partner trusted by companies across North America since 2002. We work alongside our clients to engineer, modernize, and scale the technology that powers their businesses, combining deep technical expertise, specialized teams, and shared accountability for outcomes. Key Responsibilities

- 
Develop & Improve Machine Learning Models: Build, test, and refine machine learning and statistical models to identify anomalies, forecast costs, analyze shipping rates, and classify invoices. Evaluate model performance and contribute to improving predictive accuracy.

- 
Apply AI, NLP & LLM Techniques: Explore and apply Natural Language Processing (NLP), embeddings, and Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract meaningful insights from unstructured supply chain documents, logistics contracts, and other business data.

- 
Build & Maintain Data Pipelines: Collaborate with AI and software engineers to prepare datasets, develop feature engineering workflows, and support model deployment, monitoring, and automated retraining.

- 
Conduct Exploratory & Scenario Analysis: Clean, transform, and analyze transactional datasets to identify patterns, evaluate shipping trends, compare carrier rates, and support cost optimization and contract negotiation decisions.

- 
Translate Data into Business Insights: Use SQL, statistical analysis, and data visualization to communicate findings clearly and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.

- 
Maintain Data Quality & Model Performance: Implement data quality checks, validate analytical results, monitor model performance, and follow established security and governance standards across cloud data environments.

- 
Explore & Adopt Emerging AI Tools: Proactively experiment with AI tools, libraries, and techniques to improve analytical workflows, automate repetitive tasks, accelerate experimentation, and identify new ways to solve business problems.

What You Bring

- 
Relevant Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, applied statistics, or a related analytical role, with hands-on experience working on real-world datasets and analytical projects.

- 
Python & Data Science Fundamentals: Practical experience with Python and common data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Familiarity with statsmodels or similar statistical tools is a plus.

- 
SQL & Database Knowledge: Experience writing SQL queries to retrieve, transform, and analyze data from relational databases. Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server or PostgreSQL is preferred.

- 
Machine Learning & AI: A solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including regression, classification, clustering, and time series forecasting. Exposure to NLP, embeddings, and LLMs is highly desirable, particularly through hands-on projects or practical applications.

- 
Cloud & Analytics Tools: Familiarity with cloud-based machine learning or AI platforms, preferably Azure Machine Learning or Azure AI Foundry. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Python visualization libraries is an advantage.

- 
AI-Driven Problem Solving: A proactive mindset toward exploring and applying AI tools to improve productivity, automate repetitive analytical tasks, accelerate experimentation, and develop creative solutions. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies are especially valued.

- 
Analytical Thinking & Ownership: Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work with complex datasets, validate assumptions, and draw meaningful conclusions. Comfortable taking initiative, learning independently, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

- 
Communication & Collaboration: Good English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain analytical findings and technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
